description: Shared generation-fence semantics for the Go Media Edge and the Python Voice Core. Both suites read this file; changing a rule means changing it here and in both languages. Fence fields: session_id, turn_id, generation_id, tool_epoch, session_epoch. Order is lexicographic by (session_epoch, turn_id, generation_id, tool_epoch). A cancel of fence F is F with generation_id + 1 and every other field unchanged.

order_cases.name: new turn resets nothing below it
subject switch outranks larger turn numbers
late result of an older generation
late result of an older turn
late result from before a subject switch

cancel_cases.name: a cancel must not skip a generation
a cancel must not change the turn
a cancel must not change the tool epoch
a cancel must not change the session epoch
